text: Turn every client transformation into reusable Aimparency capability
description: Define the repeatable company-autonomy architecture: owner mission and constitution, inspectable graph, evidence-linked priorities, execution loops, human and institutional gates, economic telemetry, audit and rollback, and strategy reflection. Separate reusable product primitives from client-specific adapters. Track reuse rate, founder intervention, deployment time, and marginal support cost so the business can detect and escape bespoke-consultancy dependence.

status.comment: Reusable company-autonomy operating model drafted and internally checked; awaiting user acceptance.
